coverage.inputConstraints:
The first line contains a single integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100) — the number of days for which the average air temperature is known.

The second line contains a sequence of integers t1, t2, ..., tn ( - 1000 ≤ ti ≤ 1000) — where ti is the average temperature in the i-th day. Unique output; deterministic authored oracle below implements the retained problem description.
